# openmetadata_dashboard_service (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata dashboard service by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_dashboard_service" "custom" {
  fully_qualified_name = "custom_dashboard"
}

output "custom_dashboard_service_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_dashboard_service.custom.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Dashboard service fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Dashboard service UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `connection_config` (String, Sensitive) Connector configuration as a JSON object string. Its shape depends on service_type.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Dashboard service name.
- `service_type` (String) Connector type, for example CustomDashboard, PowerBI or Tableau.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
